overview_description.description: Recall.ai is the infrastructure layer for conversation data. With a single API, developers can access recordings, transcripts, and metadata from meetings, desktops, and phone calls – without managing bots, integrations, or real-time infrastructure. Over 2,000 companies use Recall.ai to build AI products across sales, recruiting, healthcare, and productivity tools.

about_short_description.short_description: Recall.ai provides unified APIs and SDKs to capture, transcribe, and analyze recordings and meetings.

product.name: Meeting Bot API
product.description: An API for deploying bots that join video conferences to capture recordings, transcripts, participant data, chat messages, and real-time audio or video.

product.name: Desktop Recording SDK
product.description: An SDK for recording video conferences and in-person conversations through a desktop application without placing a recording bot in the meeting.

product.name: Calendar API
product.description: An API that connects calendar events with meeting recordings, providing scheduling data such as participant emails, meeting titles, and event details.

product.name: Mobile Recording SDK
product.description: A mobile SDK for capturing recordings of phone calls, VOIP calls, and in-person meetings. The product is listed as coming soon.
